title: config/views.yaml and the operator's views.yaml
description: The views of the commands (views.md, D-463 to D-468 and D-476; F-138 D2). A map from a command name to its view, which gives exactly one of `columns`, `template` and `records_template` (Decision A6). The strings that are CEL expressions (`field`, `style`, `indent`, `footer`) carry no `cel` keyword: the command layer checks them at start in a view environment of its own, by name (Decision A5).

style.description: A CEL expression over the record: the style of the row.

footer.description: A CEL expression over `records`: one line after the table.

template.description: A Mustache template, rendered once per record.

records_template.description: A Mustache template over `records`, rendered once.

field.description: A CEL expression over the record: the cell's value.

style.description: A CEL expression over the record: the style of the cell.

indent.description: A CEL expression over the record: the cell's indent level.
